name: Poisson weak scaling on 3D cuboid
description:
Weak scaling test for Poisson equation on a 3D cuboid.
The manufactured solution is a simple product of sines and cosines.
Homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions are set in direction x.

custom_commands: echo "Running profiling case: poisson_cube_weak_scaling (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Weak scaling of the Poisson model with a manufactured solution on a 3D cuboid. The grid grows in x with the MPI rank count."
echo "Physics problem: Occurs in many plasma applications."
echo "Completed profiling case: poisson_cube_weak_scaling (1 MPI ranks)"
